h1: M2 Hotel Waterside — a lakeside boutique on Kwan Phayao where you sleep to the lake and dine on the rooftop at sunset
intro: If you want a Phayao stay with a modern room whose big windows open straight onto the lake, plus a rooftop to sit, eat and drink as the sun sets over the water, M2 Hotel Waterside is the name newer travellers to Phayao keep mentioning. It's a lakeside boutique hotel on Kwan Phayao in the Ban Tom area, opened in 2021, with a clean modern design that has guests saying it feels almost European. Room types run from Standard up to a Family Room, many facing the lake, with an outdoor pool, a cafe, and the Atmosphere Sky Bar & Restaurant rooftop looking over the lake and the hills. Rooms start from around ฿1,200/night — sharp for a lake-view hotel in Phayao.

body.html: Kwan Phayao is the largest freshwater lake in northern Thailand and the heart of Phayao town. The Ban Tom side is the quieter shore — an easygoing, semi-rural stretch with rice fields, temples and lakeside eateries along the water. Modern places that genuinely face the lake here are few, and M2 Hotel Waterside, opened in 2021, is one where many rooms look straight out over the water — open the curtains and there's the lake with the distant Phu Pan hills. That's the main reason guests choose it.

The hotel is a boutique building of around 40 rooms with a clean, modern design. There are several types to suit your budget and group: from Standard Double and Standard Twin rooms for couples up to a Family Room of around 35 sqm with a queen plus a single bed, good for families. Every room has air-con, a TV, a private bathroom and large windows for the view, with many facing the lake. Most reviews praise the rooms as spacious and clean, modern in style, with comfortable beds and genuinely lovely views.

"Very modern and clean, the Kwan Phayao views are amazing — wake up and the lake fills the window. We went up to the rooftop for dinner and the sunset over the water; it felt like being in Europe, and the staff were friendly."

What sets M2 Waterside apart from the usual lakeside stays is the Atmosphere Sky Bar & Restaurant rooftop — an upstairs spot to eat and drink looking out over Kwan Phayao and the sunset on the water, the romantic touch guests praise most. Downstairs there's an outdoor pool, a cafe and a garden. Breakfast is a buffet included with the room, and at times there's a promotion that throws in a Starbucks drink per night. It suits couples, slow-travel guests after a lakeside break, and small families who want a modern, good-looking room with a view at a reachable price.

The hotel is in Ban Tom, right on Kwan Phayao — a one-minute walk to the lakeshore and about an 8-minute walk to Wat Si Khom Kham (home of the great Buddha image). Nearby lakeside sights include Wat Tilok Aram (the temple in the middle of the lake), the Phaya Ngam Mueang monument and the lakeside walking street, all an easy drive away. It suits self-drivers who want to base themselves around the lake. There's parking on site; for those without a car it's less convenient, as the town's main restaurant and shopping strip is a fair way off and not walkable.

On the numbers, M2 Waterside reviews well. Averaged across real guest reviews it sits around 8.3 out of 10 — Trip.com around 8.2 from roughly 36 guests, and it ranks near the top of Phayao town's hotels on TripAdvisor. The repeat praise is the lake view, clean and modern rooms, the rooftop atmosphere, good breakfast and restaurant, easy parking and attentive staff. The honest gripes: some rooms get ants coming in from the balcony, and the location is outside the town's main dining area, so you can't walk to food in town — you need a car.

To be straight with you, M2 Waterside positions itself as a lakeside boutique focused on view and design, not a full-service luxury resort. Its selling point is modern rooms with full lake views and a rooftop to watch the sunset over the water, at a reachable price. If your trip is about unwinding by Kwan Phayao, waking to the lake and heading up to the rooftop for an evening drink — rather than walking out to dinner in town — it lands just right. But if you don't have a car and want to walk to restaurants in town, adjust your expectations or have a ride-hailing app ready.

A tip from following the reviews here closely: specify a room that faces the lake directly if you want the full water view, as not every room sees it. In the evening, don't miss heading up to the Atmosphere Sky Bar rooftop at sunset — it's the lakeside at its prettiest. If ants worry you, keep the balcony door firmly shut and food sealed away. And since the location is outside town, drive yourself or have a ride-hailing app ready for getting into town to eat.

honestSummary: M2 Hotel Waterside is one of the best-balanced view-and-design lakeside boutiques in Phayao — modern rooms from a 2021 opening, many with full lake views, a rooftop for the sunset over Kwan Phayao, a pool and a good restaurant, at a reachable price. faq.q: Where is M2 Hotel Waterside, and how do I get there?
faq.a: It sits at 629 Moo 17, Ban Tom, Mueang Phayao, right on Kwan Phayao Lake — a one-minute walk to the lakeshore and about 8 minutes to Wat Si Khom Kham. It's around a 10–15 minute drive from Phayao town. There's parking on site, so it's ideal if you're driving. It's outside the town's main dining area, so without a car keep a ride-hailing app ready.

faq.q: How much does M2 Waterside cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from around ฿1,200/night in normal periods. There are several types: Standard Double, Standard Twin, a lake-view room, and a Family Room of around 35 sqm with a queen and a single bed for families. The hotel has around 40 rooms. Prices vary by date and holidays — compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does it really have lake views? Is there a rooftop?
faq.a: Yes — the hotel is on Kwan Phayao and many modern rooms have large windows facing the lake, so you open the curtains in the morning to the water and the distant hills. There's the Atmosphere Sky Bar & Restaurant rooftop for eating and drinking at sunset over the water, plus an outdoor pool. Not every room sees the water, so specify a lake-view room when booking.

It's best for couples, small families and anyone after a lakeside break in a modern room with a good view. There's a rooftop for the sunset and a quiet lakeside setting. If you mainly want to walk to food and shops in Phayao town and don't have a car, consider a stay in town or keep a ride-hailing app ready.

faq.q: What do the reviews say, and what are the downsides?
faq.a: The averaged real-guest score is around 8.3 out of 10 (Trip.com about 8.2 from roughly 36 guests · near the top of Phayao town on TripAdvisor). Common praise: the lake view, clean and modern rooms, the rooftop atmosphere, good breakfast and restaurant, easy parking and attentive staff. Common gripes: some rooms get ants from the balcony, and the location is outside the town's main dining area, so you can't walk to food in town — you need a car.
